articles.summary: Users who have multiple workspaces are currently unable to log in to the Langdock platform. We’re investigating the issue and will provide updates as they become available.
articles.title: Login in unavailable for users with multiple workspaces

articles.summary: Microsoft Azure is currently experiencing a downtime across its OpenAI Services in the Sweden Central region: https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status This is affecting users who configured their own OpenAI models hosted in the Sweden Central region. As a workaround, we recommend deploying the models in a different (EU) region. If you use the models provided by Langdock, this does not affect you.
articles.title: Azure OpenAI Service downtime affecting Langdock users who bring their own models

articles.summary: Image generation is temporarily unavailable across the platform. We're aware of the issue and working on a fix.
articles.title: Image generation unavailable

articles.summary: The platform is currently unavailable. We're investigating and will update you shortly.
